modules.label: Mesh, flow routing and river incision (always on)
modules.summary: Unstructured mesh, multiple-flow-direction routing with depression filling and the detachment-limited stream power law (spl: K, m, n=1); always run.

requires_any.why: Rain comes from the climate events or, instead, from the orographic model; with neither, goSPL stops at start-up with a message.

modules.mesh: both (flat plane or sphere, detected from the mesh: a mesh with domain edges is flat; vertex degree at most 12, unstructuredmesh.py:342)

modules.label: Sea level
modules.summary: Constant sea level (position, default 0 m) or a sea-level curve; sets the shoreline used by every marine process.

modules.label: Rainfall (climate events)
modules.summary: Time series of uniform, map or elevation-scaled rainfall driving runoff and discharge.

excludes.why: With an orography block the rain is computed by cptOrography and the climate rain is never read (unstructuredmesh.py:899-902); evaporation rows of the climate block are still applied.

modules.label: Evaporation
modules.summary: Evaporation per climate event, removed from the runoff source of the flow solve and from the groundwater recharge.

requires.why: Evaporation is read from the rows of the climate block (inputparser.py:1333, _defineEvap called from _readRain).

recommends.why: The recharge is infiltration times max(0, rain - evap) (gwplex.py:270-285).

modules.label: Orographic precipitation
modules.summary: Smith and Barstad linear orographic rain solved on the mesh with a uniform wind; replaces the climate rain.

excludes.why: The climate rain is ignored when orography is on (unstructuredmesh.py:899-902).

modules.mesh: flat meshes only (refused on a sphere with a message)

modules.label: Erodibility factor maps
modules.summary: Time series of uniform or mapped multipliers of the river erodibility K.

modules.label: Transport-limited deposition in rivers (G > 0)
modules.summary: Yuan et al. (2019) in-river deposition term; works with the linear, non-linear and soil-aware SPL (SPL.py:311, nlSPL.py:439, soilSPL.py:163).

modules.label: Non-linear stream power law (n != 1)
modules.summary: SNES solve of the SPL with a slope exponent n other than 1.

excludes.why: With a soil block the soil-aware SPL is used whatever n is (model.py:471-478: cptSoil is tested first); n then enters the soil residual (soilSPL.py:194).

modules.label: Soil production and soil-aware SPL
modules.summary: Soil production, soil versus bedrock erodibility and soil transport; replaces the plain SPL solve (model.py:471).

excludes.why: The soil-aware SPL replaces the non-linear SPL solver (model.py:471-478).

recommends.why: mode: regolith without a strat interval prints a warning: deposits then erode as bedrock (soilSPL.py:46-58).
Under ice the regolith is held frozen and production stops (soilSPL._iceFrozenMask, soilSPL.py:596-601).

modules.label: Continental sediment routing and deposition
modules.summary: Routes the eroded sediment downstream and deposits it in depressions and on land; on by default, off with nodep: True.

modules.label: Hillslope and marine diffusion
modules.summary: Linear or non-linear hillslope creep on land (hillslopeKa) and diffusion of marine deposits (hillslopeKm).

recommends.why: Without channelQ the diffusion acts on channel cells, so the channel steepness depends on resolution (AGENTS.md, Known limitations).

modules.label: Channel cells out of the hillslope diffusion
modules.summary: Cells with discharge above channelQ are not diffused and the hillslope supply joins the same step's river load.

requires.why: channelQ is a key of the diffusion block (inputparser.py:627); with hillslopeKa = hillslopeKm = 0 the diffusion returns at once (hillslope.py:204-206), so there is nothing to keep out of the channels.

recommends.why: With deposition on, the hillslope step moves before the sediment routing (hillFirst, model.py:494) so the supply is routed in the same step; with nodep: True it stays after the river step.

modules.label: Marine deposition of river sediment
modules.summary: Clinoform cascade and marine diffusion of the river load reaching the sea.

requires.why: The marine step runs inside the continental deposition block (model.py:500-507): nodep: True skips it.

modules.label: Marine gravity currents
modules.summary: Part of the river load reaching the sea is routed down the slope with a run-out length (hyperpycnal and turbidity currents), with optional slope erosion and failure.

requires.why: The gravity split and routing happen only inside SEAMesh.seaChange (seaplex.py:1713), called under 'if not self.nodep' and 'if self.seaDepo' (model.py:500, 507, 528); no parser check.

recommends.why: Coarse and fine fractions get their own run-out and network under dual lithology (seaplex.py:157, runout_fine).
Provenance classes ride the same gravity solve (phase G2).

modules.label: Wave energy and shadows
modules.summary: Relative wave energy per wave direction with shadowing, fetch growth and optional refraction.

requires_any.why: waveEnergy() is called only by the coastal erosion (waveplex.py:393) ...
... and by a carbonate factory with a `wave` response control (carbplex.py:616); otherwise the output waveE stays zero.

modules.mesh: both; a sphere needs `fetch` (raises, waveplex.py:69); `zonal` directions need a sphere (raises on a flat mesh, waveplex.py:75)

modules.label: Coastal erosion
modules.summary: Wave erosion of cliffs and the shallow seafloor; the eroded material joins the same step's marine routing.

requires.why: coastal_erosion: needs a `waves:` block (inputparser.py:1990).
Needs seadepo: True and nodep: False, the eroded material is spread by the marine routing (waveplex.py:81).

recommends.why: With stratigraphy the erodibility is the surface lithology K and the eroded column keeps its composition (erodeStrat); without, K = 1.
`rubble` (reef framework re-routed as another lithology) needs a reef lithology, i.e. a carbonate factory with framework (raises, inputparser.py:2007).

modules.label: Stratigraphic record
modules.block: time: strat (and optional domain: npstrata, compaction:)
modules.summary: Records layers every strat years (thickness, elevation, porosity, erodibility) with compaction; a positive `strat` interval turns it on (inputparser.py:484-490).

modules.label: Dual lithology (coarse / fine)
modules.summary: Coarse and fine sediment with their own compaction, erodibility, diffusivity and marine transport.

requires.why: Without a positive strat interval the flag is reset to False with a printed warning (inputparser.py:1634-1643).

modules.label: Additional lithologies
modules.summary: Extra lithologies (fine-like or coarse-like, own compaction, K and diffusivity) sharing their size group at every deposit.

requires.why: The list is read only after the dual-lithology test in _readLithologies (inputparser.py:1683-1710); without dual lithology it is ignored.

modules.label: Provenance tracers
modules.summary: Passive source-class labels carried through erosion, transport, deposition and the stratigraphy.

requires.why: Without a positive strat interval provenance is switched off with a printed warning (inputparser.py:2363-2371).

recommends.why: Per-class deposits are also split by fraction under dual lithology.

modules.label: Sea-surface temperature
modules.summary: Sea-surface temperature maps and/or curve through time, used by the temperature responses.

requires.why: _readSST is called from _readLithologies after the dual-lithology test (inputparser.py:1683, 1729): without dual lithology the block is ignored.

requires_any.why: Read only by a factory `temperature` response (inputparser.py:2208) ...

modules.label: Carbonate production
modules.summary: Bosscher and Schlager carbonate factories: reef framework built in place, loose carbonate sand and mud into the marine routing.

requires.why: carbonate: needs dual lithology and stratigraphy (inputparser.py:1690).
Same check: dual lithology is reset without a strat interval (inputparser.py:1634), then carbonate raises (inputparser.py:1690).
carbonate: needs seadepo: True and nodep: False (carbplex.py:76).

recommends.why: A factory `wave` response raises without a waves: block (inputparser.py:2203).
A factory `temperature` response raises without an sst: block (inputparser.py:2208).
A factory `solute` response raises without groundwater geochemistry and river_load: True (carbplex.py:107).
Carbonate on the slope can fail and be carried by the gravity currents (docs marine.rst).

modules.label: Pelagic carbonate and hemipelagic clay
modules.summary: Events of pelagic carbonate rain (preserved between lysocline and CCD) and hemipelagic clay settling on the seafloor.

requires.why: pelagic: needs dual lithology and stratigraphy (inputparser.py:1684-1689).
Same check (dual lithology is reset without a strat interval, inputparser.py:1634).

recommends.why: A `resuspend` event hands the rain to the marine diffusion only when seadepo is on and nodep off; otherwise it settles in place (carbplex.py:381-386).
An event `temperature` table raises without an sst: block (inputparser.py:2304).

modules.label: Supply-limited carbonate burial
modules.summary: Caps carbonate burial by the marine reservoir of a geochemistry species delivered by the rivers.

requires.why: Needs groundwater geochemistry with river_load: True (carbplex.py:107).
carbonate_supply: needs marine_coupling: True (carbplex.py:113).
carbSupplyLimit runs only in the seadepo block of the step (model.py:507, 516); with pelagic only and seadepo off it is never applied (carbonate itself already requires it).

requires_any.why: carbonate_supply: needs a `carbonate` or a `pelagic` block (inputparser.py:1872).

modules.label: Karst dissolution
modules.summary: Runoff dissolves the exposed carbonate lithologies from the top layer down, leaving an insoluble cover.

requires.why: karst: needs lithologies (dual lithology and a strat interval) (inputparser.py:1908).
Same check (inputparser.py:1908).

requires_any.why: A carbonate lithology to dissolve is required (reef, carb_sand or carb_mud, or listed ones), else it raises (inputparser.py:1922); the carbonate block defines them ...
... a pelagic event with carbonate rain adds carb_mud (inputparser.py:2321-2327) ...
... or strata: lithologies entries named in karst: lithologies.

recommends.why: With `species` the dissolved carbonate joins that species' river load; raises without geochemistry and river_load (carbplex.py:813).
A `temperature` response raises without an sst: block (inputparser.py:1944).

modules.label: Water table
modules.summary: Implicit Dupuit water-table head from infiltrated recharge, with seepage and baseflow.

recommends.why: aquifer_base: from_soil ties the aquifer base to the soil-bedrock interface (gwplex.py:534-546).
fine_infil_factor modulates infiltration by the exposed fine fraction only under dual lithology, otherwise ignored (gwplex.py:280).
subglacial_recharge only acts with the ice model (gwplex.py:307).

modules.label: Duricrust
modules.summary: Capillary-fringe crust that forms near the water table and armours the surface erodibility.

requires.why: Nested key of the groundwater block (inputparser.py:2934).

recommends.why: Without stratigraphy the crust is surface-only, no induration archive (gwplex.py:979).
With geochemistry the crust grows from the precipitated solute instead of form_rate (gwplex.py:154-163).

modules.label: Groundwater geochemistry
modules.summary: Conservative multi-species solutes: weathering, transport, precipitation and export.

requires.why: Nested key of the groundwater block (inputparser.py:2967).

recommends.why: weatherability_from: source_class or surface_class needs provenance, otherwise it falls back to the scalar weatherability with a message (gwplex.py:745-763).
The precipitated solute feeds the crust.

modules.label: River dissolved load
modules.summary: Routes the exported solutes down the river network to the coast.

requires.why: Key of the geochem sub-block (inputparser.py:3000); setting it makes the geochem block non-empty, so geochemistry is on.

modules.label: Marine solute reservoir
modules.summary: Accumulates the solutes delivered at the coast into a marine reservoir per species.

requires.why: Allocated and updated only inside the river-load routing (gwplex.py:229-233, 1458, 1503); without river_load nothing happens.

modules.label: Diagnostic glacial model
modules.summary: ELA accumulation routed into an ice discharge, Bahr thickness, sliding, abrasion, till and meltwater.

recommends.why: The ice load is added to the flexural load when flexure is on (addprocess.py:644-646, iceplex.py:81).
Same for global flexure (addprocess.py:644-646).
Till is recorded in the stratigraphy when it is on (iceplex.py:530).

modules.label: Flexural isostasy, flat ('fem')
modules.summary: Parallel finite-volume biharmonic plate flexure on the flat mesh, with edge boundary conditions.

excludes.why: One method per run (flexure: method, inputparser.py:2519-2528).

modules.mesh: flat meshes only: without `method`, flexure uses this solver on a flat mesh (method: fem); set on a sphere it stops with a message

modules.label: Flexural isostasy, global
modules.summary: Spherical-harmonic flexure on a Driscoll-Healy grid, serial on rank 0.
modules.mesh: spheres only: without `method`, flexure uses this solver on a sphere (method: global); set on a flat mesh it stops with a message

modules.label: Elastic thickness maps
modules.summary: Spatially and temporally varying elastic thickness.

requires_any.why: Read only by the flexure solve (_updateTe, addprocess.py:88-120) ...

modules.label: Uplift and subsidence
modules.summary: Vertical displacement rates per tectonic event, applied at the start of each step.

modules.label: Horizontal advection (upwind / iioe1 / iioe2)
modules.summary: Eulerian advection of the surface and stratigraphy by the horizontal velocity of each tectonic event.
modules.mesh: flat or cyclic (designed for 2D meshes; on a sphere only the stratigraphy transport is tested, docs tech_guide/tecto.rst:44)

modules.label: Plate interpolation
modules.summary: Lagrangian move of the mesh nodes by the event displacement, re-interpolated on the mesh (mainly global models).

modules.label: Plate interpolation remaps
modules.summary: Applies each event's displacement in remaps of about this many mesh spacings, with barycentric weights.

requires.why: domain: interp_remap only applies to advect: 'interp' (inputparser.py:372).

modules.label: Cyclic (periodic) boundaries
modules.summary: Periodic North/South or East/West edges on a cylinder mesh.
modules.mesh: flat (cylinder) mesh only; the mesh must be a cylinder (not checked: a planar mesh does not wrap); serial only (raises at np > 1, inputparser.py:267); edges in pairs (inputparser.py:242-257); bc is ignored on a sphere
